newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Byblos Bank expects Moody's rating.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Byblos Bank expects Moody's rating.

text.p: Lebanon's Byblos Bank on Tuesday said it had just concluded a meeting with Moody's Investors Service and would be rated by the end of July.
Byblos, which on Tuesday announced a 41.2 percent rise in mid-year net profits, also said it would meet with the European credit rating agency IBCA to obtain a rating. It did not specify a time.
Byblos' mid-year net profits climbed to 23.015 billion Lebanese pounds ($15 million) from 16.293 billion pounds for the first half of 1996.

Beirut banking sources said several top Beirut commercial banks had applied to Moody's for ratings in the last few months. Moody's had set up a committee for Lebanon and the ratings would be issued together, a source told Reuters.
Banks had also applied to Standard & Poor's and IBCA, he added.
